I saved Pree's new cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork, 21 October from now on, as a private memory under her name. I also confirmed it to her in your DM.

My first save came out visible to anyone who can read the shared brain, not just Pree. Since she told me in a DM, I saved it again as private and withdrew the shared copy. Withdrawing only stops it from coming up when people look things up. The brain keeps an audit record of it.

I didn't find any earlier cutoff for her in the brain, but search was running in keyword-only mode, so an older note worded differently could have been missed.
